description: Repository-owned HelloTest feature backlog and connected synthetic acceptance data. Version 7 covers every implemented feature Story with a case, capability suites, chronological delivery and mixed run evidence, plus independent prompt templates and synthetic agent/chat history. Existing records, dates, custom grants and assignments are retained.

blueprint.title: HelloTest core feature and acceptance-story blueprint

modules.label: Workspace roles
modules.description: Selectable role presets for product, QA, automation, AI, reporting and read-only collaboration. Existing roles, grants and assignments are retained.

modules.label: Projects & applications
modules.description: A private HelloTest Launchpad with Web, API and Mobile scopes and missing memberships for all active workspace administrators.

modules.label: Stories, sprints & releases
modules.description: HelloTest feature stories with detailed acceptance criteria, short Sprint and Release plans, delivery milestones and connected examples.

modules.label: Test design & shared steps
modules.description: Web, API and mobile cases organized into multiple suites and modules with preconditions, local groups, reusable shared steps and matching parameters.

modules.label: Environments, data & configuration
modules.description: Staging scopes, browser and mobile profiles, and varied customer and payment data.

modules.label: Defects & collaboration
modules.description: Open, triaged and resolved defects with root causes, comments and a converted regression test.

modules.label: Runs & case execution
modules.description: Multiple saved sample runs with passed, failed, blocked and skipped outcomes, frozen context and exact Defect links.

modules.label: Knowledge repository
modules.description: Searchable product rules, API contracts and repository guidance with source citations.

modules.label: Object repository & API tests
modules.description: Named screen objects with stable locators and API cases with requests and assertions.

modules.label: Agents & prompt templates
modules.description: Draft HelloTest specialist workflows and clearly marked synthetic workflow history. No automatic execution.

modules.label: Dashboards & release readiness
modules.description: Executive, Product and QA dashboards calculate metrics from the connected sample records.

modules.label: Integration setup examples
modules.description: Inactive, credential-free configuration examples for every supported integration type.

modules.label: Schedules & activity
modules.description: Disabled run schedules and an explicitly labeled sample activity timeline.

modules.label: AI prompt templates
modules.description: Reviewed Story, test-case and Defect templates shared across AI authoring workflows.

modules.label: Ask HelloTest history
modules.description: Authored conversations demonstrate readable responses and recovery states. No provider is called during setup.
